description: 핀로그 — 미니 위젯 타임 트래커 & 일기장

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.check:ui: electron-vite build && electron scripts/check-widget-fit.js && electron scripts/check-drag-regions.js && electron scripts/check-composer-window.js && electron scripts/check-input-flow.js && electron scripts/check-avatar.js && electron scripts/check-category.js && electron scripts/check-onboarding.js && electron scripts/check-onboarding-input.js && electron scripts/check-desktop-layout.js
scripts.check:rewards: electron-vite build && vite build --config scripts/toss-mock/vite.config.ts && electron scripts/check-rewards.js
scripts.check:e2e: electron-vite build && electron scripts/check-e2e.js && electron scripts/check-settings.js
